# `aitbc monitor metrics`

Collect and display system metrics for a time period.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc monitor metrics [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--period` | text | `24h` | no | Time period (1h, 24h, 7d, 30d) |
| `--export` | path | — | no | Export metrics to file |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc monitor metrics
```
